title: Skin First
caption:
Skin First

My work is makeup —
its importance, and its pleasure.
Yet the longer I practise it,
the clearer it becomes:
what matters most is the skin beneath,
and the person who wears it.

When I was younger,
I believed makeup could cover for skipped skincare.
Time has taught me otherwise.
The foundation beneath is everything.

Humidity, sun, heat —
each city asks something different of the skin.
As a makeup artist,
I want to offer skincare that answers to where you live.

The ritual before your makeup
may have more to give than you think.
